subject: How we're advocating for a PDAB

body:
freedomva.org [freedomva.org]
Freedom Virginia has been working to establish a Prescription Drug Affordability Board in Virginia for years.
An important part of our advocacy comes from having real stories of the impact of rising prescription costs in Virginia.
We are reaching out to our supporters, not to ask for contributions, but for something more valuable: can you share your experience with us?
If you have a story you would be willing to share you can fill out our form here.
Visit our form here [https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLScVuX1t13Jy8hn0lVLB63gXZ7r2kdrJBJ39MoFEevbla7orSQ/viewform?usp=sf_link]
A great example of where those stories go is our annual storybook. When advocating to legislators about the importance of passing a PDAB we bring a book with us full of stories like these from real Virginians.
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMMP/1/85567/images/story%20blitz%202%20am.png]
Your story will help us remind legislators why a PDAB is so important in Virginia.
Thank you for your support!
Eddie Seay,

name: Courtney Bourgoin, Evergreen
subject: Another utility scandal just broke
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY EVERGREEN ACTION
body:
That's not what ratepayer money is supposed to pay for
| | | | | [](https://act.evergreenaction.com/go/339?t=2&akid=13932%2E53494%2E4fCkPq)
---
| | **Get this, Friend:** Michigan residents pay some of the **highest energy bills** in the country. A Detroit Free Press story just broke that helps explain why. (We know it's not for clean, reliable energy.)
---
[](https://act.evergreenaction.com/go/5094?t=3&akid=13932%2E53494%2E4fCkPq)
---
DTE Energy, the state's largest power company, **provides some of the dirtiest, least reliable energy in the country** —and just bumped up its rates by 6.4 percent.
---
[**FUND OUR FIGHT AGAINST DIRTY UTILITIES**](https://act.evergreenaction.com/go/5090?t=5&akid=13932%2E53494%2E4fCkPq)
---
So where is all that ratepayer money going?

Instead of using ratepayer funds to benefit its customers, **DTE charged its customers an eye-popping $5.3 million to pay for membership dues to shady groups like Edison Electric Institute (EEI)** and fund fancy getaways to curry favor with local utility regulators.

This is the same EEI we told you about earlier this year—the one lobbying to block critical climate action. **Tens of thousands of Evergreen action-takers like you stepped up to call for utility transparency and accountability. We got their attention, but the fight isn't over.**

EEI is fighting back, and the current situation in Michigan proves there's still more work to be done. So, we're going to push even harder.

**Next up : We're backing efforts in states across the country to make it illegal for utilities to charge customers for their dirty lobbying—[and we need your help.](https://act.evergreenaction.com/go/5090?t=6&akid=13932%2E53494%2E4fCkPq)**
---
[HELP US REACH OUR FUNDRAISING GOAL](https://act.evergreenaction.com/go/5090?t=8&akid=13932%2E53494%2E4fCkPq)
---
Thank you for your support,

Courtney Bourgoin
Senior Policy and Advocacy Manager, Midwest
Evergreen Action
---
|
---
**P.S.** The fact is anti-climate lobbying is costing Michiganders millions of dollars each year. Even Republican Senator Ed McBroom called the whole scheme "a little obscene." With EEI's fossil fuel influence extending beyond the Great Lakes region, **it's going to take all of us to demand utilities stand up for their customers, clean energy, and climate action.[Chip in now.](https://act.evergreenaction.com/go/5099?t=9&akid=13932%2E53494%2E4fCkPq)**

subject: They call me a socialist
body:
| | | [ ](https://www.shrewsburyforsenate.com/r?u=sTrCoaT-YmDhY88aC-xe_4EuiRHvEQu_OzjBiZlAGzs2u921EReiR88ARqrt5HWpbBPunnEofCMh9dr_AFzKQb6EWFMIxSFFFKqdIp7dWeI&e=835c7faa13004566534194ac192acb50&utm_source=shrewsburyforsenate&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=122123_socialist&n=1)
---
Dear Friend, I recently played Santa at a community event organized by a tiny group of dedicated volunteers. All kids and their families received a meal, and each child not only got a gift for themselves but also got to pick a gift for each sibling and each parent. It was a fantastic event for a very underserved community in West Virginia. A community gathered for a common cause, pooling and distributing resources to those in need. Events like these are plentiful nationwide because we are a generous species. "From each according to their ability, to each according to their needs" is something we practice in many contexts. We teach our children to live by this standard. Yet, when it comes to politics, the media are quick to use the term "socialist" to dismiss, ridicule, or demonize a candidate. Shortly after Manchin announced his retirement from the U.S. Senate and I became the only candidate in this race, the media were eager to report about our campaign, and almost all jumped on the opportunity to label me a "socialist." They knew the articles would get more clicks, generate outrage, raise eyebrows, or roll eyes. After all, they've been brainwashing the public with the propaganda of socialism being America's greatest enemy for more than 100 years. FDR was called a socialist by the oligarchs of his time, who opposed New Deal programs like Social Security, unemployment compensation, the right to form a union, the minimum wage, regulation of Wall Street, and massive infrastructure improvements. Lyndon Johnson was called a socialist when he enacted Medicare and Medicaid in the 1960s and launched the War on Poverty. President Barack Obama was called a socialist when he fought for and signed the Affordable Care Act. Civil rights icon Dr. Martin Luther King, Jr addressed the issue majestically when he said, "Call it democracy or call it democratic socialism, but there must be a better distribution of wealth in this country for all of God's children." We all know the price we have paid and continue to pay for the rampant economic inequality we have experienced for the past 40 years:
* Stagnant wages
* Abandoned communities
* Healthcare bankruptcies
* Increasing poverty among the elderly
* Rising deaths of despair from suicide
* Soaring college debt

**I say enough is enough.** **If being a socialist means strengthening social security, empowering workers to organize unions, enacting a higher minimum wage, regulating Wall Street, providing healthcare for all, and investing in massive public infrastructure projects to rebuild our communities and employ our workers at good paying sustainable jobs, then count me in!** If you agree that it's time we embrace "from each according to their ability, to each according to their needs" and work together towards a prosperous, just, equitable, and healthy country, then **[help us win this senate seat by contributing today.](https://www.shrewsburyforsenate.com/r?u=sTrCoaT-YmDhY88aC-xe_4EuiRHvEQu_OzjBiZlAGzs2u921EReiR88ARqrt5HWpbBPunnEofCMh9dr_AFzKQb6EWFMIxSFFFKqdIp7dWeI&e=835c7faa13004566534194ac192acb50&utm_source=shrewsburyforsenate&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=122123_socialist&n=2)** We have only a few days left in 2023, and our campaign needs you. clean_body: | | | Dear Friend, I recently played Santa at a community event organized by a tiny group of dedicated volunteers. All kids and their families received a meal, and each child not only got a gift for themselves but also got to pick a gift for each sibling and each parent. It was a fantastic event for a very underserved community in West Virginia. A community gathered for a common cause, pooling and distributing resources to those in need. Events like these are plentiful nationwide because we are a generous species. "From each according to their ability, to each according to their needs" is something we practice in many contexts. We teach our children to live by this standard. Yet, when it comes to politics, the media are quick to use the term "socialist" to dismiss, ridicule, or demonize a candidate. Shortly after Manchin announced his retirement from the U.S. Senate and I became the only candidate in this race, the media were eager to report about our campaign, and almost all jumped on the opportunity to label me a "socialist." They knew the articles would get more clicks, generate outrage, raise eyebrows, or roll eyes. After all, they've been brainwashing the public with the propaganda of socialism being America's greatest enemy for more than 100 years. FDR was called a socialist by the oligarchs of his time, who opposed New Deal programs like Social Security, unemployment compensation, the right to form a union, the minimum wage, regulation of Wall Street, and massive infrastructure improvements. Lyndon Johnson was called a socialist when he enacted Medicare and Medicaid in the 1960s and launched the War on Poverty. President Barack Obama was called a socialist when he fought for and signed the Affordable Care Act. Civil rights icon Dr. Martin Luther King, Jr addressed the issue majestically when he said, "Call it democracy or call it democratic socialism, but there must be a better distribution of wealth in this country for all of God's children." We all know the price we have paid and continue to pay for the rampant economic inequality we have experienced for the past 40 years: Stagnant wages Abandoned communities Healthcare bankruptcies Increasing poverty among the elderly Rising deaths of despair from suicide Soaring college debt I say enough is enough. If being a socialist means strengthening social security, empowering workers to organize unions, enacting a higher minimum wage, regulating Wall Street, providing healthcare for all, and investing in massive public infrastructure projects to rebuild our communities and employ our workers at good paying sustainable jobs, then count me in! If you agree that it's time we embrace "from each according to their ability, to each according to their needs" and work together towards a prosperous, just, equitable, and healthy country, then We have only a few days left in 2023, and our campaign needs you. week, MAGA House Republicans voted to officially begin their sham
impeachment inquiry into President Biden.

So far, they’ve presented zero evidence of any wrongdoing by the
President.

They’re doing it anyway – to appease Donald Trump – plain and simple.

I took my role seriously as the lead impeachment manager in the first
trial against Donald Trump in 2019. I followed the rule of law and my oath

extorting Ukraine by withholding much-needed military aid in the fight
against the Russian invaders, by conditioning that aid on a political
investigation smearing Joe Biden.

Likewise in the second impeachment, the evidence of Trump’s efforts to
overturn the election, and his incitement of insurrection, were plain for
all to see.

Flashforward to last week: House Republicans have launched an impeachment
inquiry into President Biden with no evidence.

It’s a partisan stunt, just like the censure vote against me earlier this
year.

It’s a tactic to uplift Donald Trump’s campaign, to go after his political
rivals, and to dilute the stain of Trump’s multiple impeachments and
indictments.

One of my Republican colleagues was asked about the impeachment inquiry.
His response? “Donald J. Trump 2024, Baby!”

quiet while they move forward with this sham impeachment inquiry. I will

| **Central Valley Leadership Round Table Endorses ****John Duarte for Congress **
---
| **(Modesto, CA)****** — Today, John Duarte announces an endorsement from the Central Valley Leadership Round Table. The Central Valley Leadership Round Table (CVLRT) is a group of elected officials and community leaders in Fresno County, Madera County, Stanislaus County and Merced County, many of whom are former farm laborers or the children of farm workers.

The President of the CVLRT, Mr. Eliseo Gamiño stated “I am pleased to have John Duarte’s commitment to work with CVLRT members to improve the livelihoods of all of his constituency. Among the pressing issues in the San Joaquin Valley includes real immigration reform for families, DACA, quality education in our K-12 Public School System; especially math and English Language Arts, affordable housing, and affordable rent to name a few.”

Congressman John Duarte released the following statement regarding the endorsement:

“I’m a fourth-generation Central Valley farmer who believes we need to create more opportunities for hard-working people to achieve the American dream. In Washington, I’m fighting for the farmers, working people, and middle-class families who are struggling from unaffordable everyday prices. I’m honored to have received an endorsement from the Central Valley Leadership Round Table. It is a testament to our common vision of building a better future for our Valley.”

John Duarte is the first Republican to have been endorsed by the Central Valley Leadership Round Table. John Duarte’s campaign has continued to secure endorsements from Latino community leaders, businesses, and organizations throughout the Valley. The growing support among the Latino community is a testament to John’s mission in Congress to work across the aisle and find real solutions for the Valley.

| We just got big news in the Michigan Senate race, team: A new poll shows that our general election race is a DEAD HEAT against two of our Republican opponents. Elissa Slotkin: 39%
Mike Rogers: 37%

James Craig: 38% We have a slight edge, but this poll makes it clear that no matter who our Republican opponent is, there is a lot of work to do in order to take Elissa’s positive, affirmative message to undecided voters across the state next year. [_Will you split a contribution between the Voter Protection Project and our campaign to help us make the important investments we’ll need to win this race?_](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/58612?t=6&akid=12192%2E878179%2E8ZUAYl) | [DONATE NOW »](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/58612?t=7&akid=12192%2E878179%2E8ZUAYl)

With the retirement of Joe Manchin in West Virginia, we know that Michigan’s open Senate seat will be even more critical in determining whether or not Democrats maintain control of the Senate next year. And this poll makes it clear that, as a swing state, nothing in Michigan is ever guaranteed.

The Detroit Free Press said: ”But it's such a small lead — well within the margin of error — that it could indicate trouble for Democrats in retaining the seat...Such large numbers of undecided voters make it clear that all of the candidates still have a lot of ground to make up in introducing themselves to voters.”

So, what does this mean? The big takeaways for our race in this open seat are that while this is a two-point margin, over 20% of voters are undecided. We’ve been doing everything we can to take our message directly to voters early by visiting cities and towns all over Michigan and meeting with folks to talk about the issues that matter to them. In addition, we know that millions of dollars from Republican mega-donors and conservative Super PACs is on the way to prop up our eventual opponent.

Elissa is a data nerd, so this kind of poll really does guide our decisions about TV ads, digital outreach, hiring staff early, and building a ground-game that meets folks where they are.That’s why the most important time to donate is now. Contributions a year from now, when we’re in the home stretch are helpful. But everything we raise now will help us be strategic and intentional about how – and when – we’re reaching voters.

**That’s why we’re asking for your support:** [_Will you chip in now to help us continue reaching undecided voters, expand our lead in this race, and protect Michigan’s Senate seat for Democrats?_](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/58612?t=8&akid=12192%2E878179%2E8ZUAYl)

Greg

name: Grace Jo
subject: This is what I remember about North Korea…
body:
| | Please see a special message from our sponsor.

[](http://trk.secureandprosper.)Fellow American,

I grew Have you ever felt your stomach empty and hurt for days at a time? I grew up in North Korea in the 90s during one of the world’s worst famines.

During that time, I only ate about 1 meal a week — a little rice, mostly wild vegetables from the mountains, tree leaves, and tree barks. Sometimes, even mice that we caught.

The food situation was very bad. In 1998, my grandmother and younger brothers all passed away because of starvation. My youngest brother starved to death when he was only 2 months old.

My younger brother and I were starved for 10 days straight. We only drank cold water because there was no food we could find.

And my father was tortured and starved to death. He passed away when North Korean agents transferred him from a countryside detention center to a city detention center for a court trial.

His “crime” was only that he left his country in search of food for his family.

The sad part is that my experience is normal for regular citizens in North Korea.

I am Grace Jo, a speaker with the Dissident Project. The Dissident Project brings survivors of authoritarian socialist countries to high schools around the United States to tell them about our experiences.

[Fellow American, can you donate $10, $35, $50, or any amount to help me speak to high school students? _Click here to send your support >>>_](http://trk.secureandprosper._lBlmAE2Zt37A)

I’m actually one of the lucky ones.

My family tried to escape many times, but each time, we were repatriated to North Korea by the Chinese government and imprisoned upon our return.

I finally escaped for good in 2006, but not without help. _Pastor Philip Buck bribed North Korean agents with $10,000_ to let me, my mother, and my sister (my only remaining family members) leave for China.

The true horrors of communism are responsible for my family starving to death because of the actions of a totalitarian government.

**_I want to make sure that never happens in America_.**

By sharing my story with high school students, I can show them how lucky they are to live in a free country. That’s why we’ve set a goal to raise $10,000 this month to help Dissident Project speakers share their stories with students.

| As we reflect on the blessings of this year, we're grateful to have so many supporters and partners who helped make all of our accomplishments possible in 2023.
From Greater Georgia's Candidate Recruitment Program, to our Election Integrity Defenders Initiative, and our statewide high school voter registration competition - the last twelve months were filled with results-oriented efforts to build Georgia's conservative infrastructure.
Even outside a major election year, we made more than 125,000 voter contacts and recruited over 60 candidates to run for local office. We held dozens of voter registration and community outreach events - and made progress in the effort to clean up our state's voter rolls.
We also helped lead the charge to close Georgia's "Zuckerbucks loophole" with a new law, SB 222. And we fought tirelessly to hold our state's election officials accountable for a much-needed voting machine update.
We encourage you to read our 2023 Year End Report [HERE](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001Ds_b9c2PfnqK9fJdut-TrE7yletj6M6JlSJ522DzfIJkQMqKi9dlR-UdsiOz7f9THzV3HioD9yWWncNoiCcNbBWIzsFe5t7nfHXA0ws0Jht3euraMu_z1sKpUiDCTvIvBZAUgu2WrmhUOqv_d6_4WfCTGXyBUVo5Q5F7tWe9paw=&c=Cceyb6LKmFfzkwpTON2MvbpetgRGbogCeUrqVQQUMYY1ytCaS7g9VQ==&ch=F9WUwjiJsvSHLSkqzFwg5u193_8BpORYtEGJDMYr4hFg2jAbFSf5uQ==) \- where you'll also find my Christmas message.
2024 will be a critical year for the conservative movement in our effort to push back on the ever-rising extremes of the Left. But after three years of Greater Georgia's continuous, boots-on-the-ground work - we believe that, with the partnership of great patriots like you, we are well-positioned going into the new year.
Thank you to our interns, volunteers, grassroots partners, and supporters: you have made Greater Georgia the state's top conservative registration, mobilization, and election integrity watchdog. Together, we'll accomplish even more in 2024.
On behalf of the Greater Georgia team, we wish you a joyful, peaceful Christmas season with friends and family. We're excited to work alongside you in the New Year.
Merry Christmas!

name: Riley Gaines
subject: Join Me in Standing Up for Women’s Sports and American Values
body:
Below is an email I’m circulating to outstanding leaders and principled conservatives like you.

| | | [](https://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2zsuh732v1dj9rqqv262rm2pn2idfmv4vhhsv3km0_rp22sh2s8i6eo36c9im0o36c9h2bs)
Hi Fellow American,

Below is an email I'm circulating to outstanding leaders and principled conservatives like you. I think you may be interested in seeing it.

Please review the message at your earliest convenience and let me know if you would like to participate.

Best wishes,

Riley Gaines

P.S. The deadline is approaching to raise $1.5 million to host my upcoming college campus tour. If you'd like to give online, here's a secure link for you:
**[https://secured.leadershipinstitute.org/rgc-082424/](https://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2zfb6gpr064etndg2lh0m0mgvcc4bntd12tnpb7l8_rp22sh2s8i6eo36c9im0o36c9h2bs)**

* * *

From: Riley Gaines <rileygaines@email.leadershipinstitute.org>
Send Date: August 9, 2023 9:55 AM
Subject: Did you see my announcement?

Dear Friend,

I hope you saw my announcement on Sean Hannity's show that I've partnered with the Leadership Institute to launch the Riley Gaines Center.

I'm the 12-time All-American swimmer who speaks out against transgender ideology and fights to defend basic truths - that men are men and women are women.

The Riley Gaines Center at the Leadership Institute is now the exclusive headquarters of my work to lead conservatives of all types - patriots who will not be silenced by the weight of the left's cultural pressure and who want to learn how to defend America's freedoms.

When the left tries to shout you down profanely, when they viciously attack you - that's when you know you're saying the right things.

For those who are attacked, vilified, and persecuted for their support of America's founding principles and traditional American values, the Riley Gaines Center sends a message that they are not alone - because I will stand bravely with them.

To train as many young people as I can to stand up for conservative principles, I must have the help of strong Leadership Institute supporters like you.

**[Will you help turn young men and women into Leaders for America?](https://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2zl54ia7cap8i7uu0pep0g5ujl17ehsa4tm61fr6o_rp22sh2s8i6eo36c9im0o36c9h2bs)**

The Riley Gaines Center is the exclusive home of my work to lead this crucial cause through:

* Speaking events and media appearances to rally everyday Americans to defend women's identity and uphold vital truths.

* A coalition of women, student athletes, parents, and those who have been harmed by radical transgender ideology, to join me in speaking out across the country.

* A fast-growing team of speakers and grassroots organizers, who will help turn those ready to defend freedom into champions who put their principles into action.

---
Through the Riley Gaines Center, my fellow Leadership Institute colleagues and I will identify, recruit, train, mentor, and empower students, athletes, and parents across the country to become campus, community, and national Leaders for America.

Not only will these young leaders help our country right now. They will stand up for our principles for decades to come.

**[By joining me and the Leadership Institute team with your contribution to this new effort, you make a powerful difference for conservatives across the country, from college campuses to the halls of power.](https://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2zf8g9urvunqml1caqj9nnejfsh6gj1ih49j5cce8_rp22sh2s8i6eo36c9im0o36c9h2bs)**

Thank you for your support and dedication to preserving commonsense truths and conservative principles in our country.

Stand bravely with me,

Riley Gaines
The Riley Gaines Center at the Leadership Institute
---
The Leadership Institute, 1101 N. Highland St., Steven P.J. Wood Building, Arlington, VA 22201, United States

---

American Defense News
---

I am incredibly humbled by the supportive messages, encouragement, and donations from people across the country. We’re building our movement to unseat Marjorie Taylor Greene around our shared values of compassion and kindness. Because of you, we’re starting this campaign on the right foot. **If you didn’t donate to our launch, don’t worry, you still can **[by clicking here!](https://default.salsalabs.org/Tc28971eb-8932-4fcf-bc65-d641014c9688/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9) [**DONATE $7 NOW >>**](https://default.salsalabs.org/T9a3b3c84-4f6b-45b2-a888-18571fc814ba/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9) [](https://default.salsalabs.org/T15786cd9-9b75-4c76-b846-f3cb82b07805/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9) As a reminder: my name is Shawn Harris. ## Czech Gunman Kills 14 in Prague
A 24-year-old university student [killed 14 people ](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxs0DFzhCAUBOBfAx0OPFCTgiKN3aVN6RB46Mtw4gDq3L_PmDrtbvPtfj3mh6NE2_LpnmhbzLPzjU6cFQgAAXo2PNiICKg5WjVKDb0BrfhqY4hmjNHHwcOb1gYAUbpv6ZWJyviBkwUJWgGAkn3f685EM4zvOEJUxoDsmZEYqOXS_WTa2ooxvfKJpfP5yZNdW9sr0x8MJgbTdV1dwaNhqXd_J7mkwGDCo-QdGUx7ccuB4tjoxFKpvURdc260LSKhO7GKiicWl0RAF8SeE3kU1b3EDRX3ZsVg4sWG_aKUqA4jM3J5Okp_pvb_Rb8BAAD__yqVaIA)and injured 25 more at Charles University in Prague Thursday, the worst mass shooting in Czech Republic history. The gunman was "eliminated," police said. The shooting took place near a busy tourist zone in Prague. [Dramatic video](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxs0LFu6yAUgOGngc0WHMDYA8N1rrylS4eOyIFDcipiIkxj9e2rdO78Db_0f5z9eaVM2_VtvaNrqfg1NHqil9ABdKC85tElREDF0UkrFBgNSvKbSyOMaIewxoijSAqNmAZEsGMYJ6MsJwcClAQAKYwxqtdJD3ZCC0lqDcIwLTBSK7X_LLS1G6b8XZ5Y-1DuPLtba4-dqX8MFgbLcRz95RJexmDZ8NgZLJme-LJSc-zwq5YHdoO1kwEjmVr2GnypdKWNqf_zfHr383zi1cXHQTnTPlimxfW-Uv5Ntr8P_AQAAP__5uVaSg) shows people leaping from a ledge at the university to escape and others racing down the street to get away. Police gave no motive for the shooting but said they didn't consider it an act of terrorism. They believe the gunman was responsible [for several murders](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskL2O8yAQAJ_G7hzBsv6hoPiadPnaK601LPZGxFiYJLq3P-XqK0dTjDRft_lGkmRf_9ODXY15Jl_lxbOGDqADM2MbXGQGNi07PSoDPYLR7ebGYfSBydgF1DQhkGUVep4oelDLgK04UGA0AGjV9725YMRhtDxC1Iig-gYVB6m5XO5Z9rpxTN_5xeXi86NNbqv1OBvzr4FrA1c6dn6fH_WBUsUnbuB6FFqf3J1bzlX2tQtMoZP9_iwcOktmMosfrLZeLypYsD6qgQgnPRnUbXHheEtKcg5jg2p9kKTfev17xk8AAAD__zQSXig) before Thursday's shooting, including killing his father.
## Giuliani Files for Bankruptcy
Rudy Giuliani [filed for bankruptcy](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskD-LhDAUxD9N7CLJS1y1sFg47PaK4-BKifHpvt38ERNX9tsfXn3VDDMMDL-f23Az5Cgsn8Zjl-c4GJvphYMEDsBBDbqYuhkRUBXYyVooqDQoWdw7LdpLa8dGK2V11ZpRqMlWjTCNhlaNTUEdCFASAKSoqkqVetaXusUaZqk1iIppgRPluJWPSCHfcXbv-MKttNEXrrvnvCamrgx6Bv1xHKVP4ewY9Bj4nhj0AY9T1ugokz3tQrsjE4gnxGfiownPbV-zfXMzZ9y41A335BzFwB_7tHgMmVPgE87Gm3zG1iRk0JuNX6_SfX1_7MXWTetxrtKlZlos3pD7u5n_p_YbAAD__-rWbog) Thursday after being hit with a $148 million defamation judgment last week for defaming two Georgia election workers. Giuliani listed his net worth as up to $10 million and his current debt at $151 million. Giuliani will get protection from some creditors, but not all. Damages stemming from a defamation ruling can't be eliminated in bankruptcy, and the judge ordered Giuliani to start paying the $148 million immediately. According to the filing, in addition to the jury penalty, [Giuliani owes ](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxsj7GOtCAURp8GOg1cULSg-Bu7-dstDQOX8e6iGMVxffuNW2_3JV9yTs7HY3w4SrS8_rsZbYl5dL7QG0cJFUAFatQ82IgIqDhaaYSCRoOSfLJ937ed6J4GsVVtp1EKEYzsQjQ-eu85WRCgJABI0TSNqnXUrenRQJRag2iYFhio5K3-zLSUCWO68hu32ueZJzuVsu5M_WMwMBjO86zdN-X9fhkMN5vBIOHeksGwHeGqXnQkcgtVT7d8bcda_FUFfBa-2bCelBLtrWFavGZH6ddT_s7-CQAA___irVcX)nearly $1 million in taxes and at least $3.4 million in potential liabilities from other lawsuits.
## Survey: A Sports Fan's Political Primer
LIV Golf attracts fans who are more politically liberal, while the PGA Tour leans right, with 56% of PGA fans self-identifying as "more conservative," according to a survey by The Harris Poll and Sportico. [The survey includes a chart](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxs0LFuxCAQBNCvgQ4LFrDPBUUaukub0sK-xd6IOywgtvL3kSOlSzPVk2Y0H_fpHijRa30PT3Qt5iksjQ6cFAgAAXoy_OEiIqDm6NQgNVgDWvHNWRvnm9QS-lmraMdbNHEJiDdj7TiHmZMDCVoBgJLWWt2ZaPphxAGiMgakZUbig1ou3WemV9swpu98YOmW_OTJba3tlek3Bp6BP8-zq3sujZZ8AQY-YVi_sDLwa06Rgb_6GPgtlEJV_Gmx55SuoEZLFTG8xBwqVpHoEPsahAJthl4qOTLwvLjHflJKVPuBGbk-A6XfRe3_g34CAAD__y7xZbI) showing the political skew of various sports. College football is the most conservative-leaning, while tennis is the most liberal. The poll also notes that how fans perceive the political tilt of a sport is sometimes at odds with the actual politics of the fan base. For example, 63% thought women's basketball was "more liberal," but in fact, 55% of its fans identify as conservative.

Our first edition goes out on January 9th, and you can if you'd like to get on the list. | Czech Gunman Kills 14 in Prague A 24-year-old university student injured 25 more at Charles University in Prague Thursday, the worst mass shooting in Czech Republic history. The gunman was "eliminated," police said. The shooting took place near a busy tourist zone in Prague. shows people leaping from a ledge at the university to escape and others racing down the street to get away. Police gave no motive for the shooting but said they didn't consider it an act of terrorism. They believe the gunman was responsible before Thursday's shooting, including killing his father. Giuliani Files for Bankruptcy Rudy Giuliani Thursday after being hit with a $148 million defamation judgment last week for defaming two Georgia election workers. Giuliani listed his net worth as up to $10 million and his current debt at $151 million. Giuliani will get protection from some creditors, but not all. Damages stemming from a defamation ruling can't be eliminated in bankruptcy, and the judge ordered Giuliani to start paying the $148 million immediately. According to the filing, in addition to the jury penalty, $1 million in taxes and at least $3.4 million in potential liabilities from other lawsuits. Survey: A Sports Fan's Political Primer LIV Golf attracts fans who are more politically liberal, while the PGA Tour leans right, with 56% of PGA fans self-identifying as "more conservative," according to a survey by The Harris Poll and Sportico. showing the political skew of various sports. College football is the most conservative-leaning, while tennis is the most liberal. name: Reclaiming American Freedom
subject: Survey on the Department of Justice
body:
The survey will only take a few moments of your time

This sponsored message from Reclaiming American Freedom is on behalf of Hillsdale College
[](http://links.reclamingamericanfreedom.com/u/click?_t=5ec072595b1347f09b4bac0de82ea87d&_m=412bff79324d41c59b4bbf30ed5284a3&_e=QlRsipEQJpq6Qv7_WM5_hLTqWaF98KYNBsSccJQh97HQ5A53FsQ8kLEp7Kr47ABur6aY6fWskZyxNFVo3S4k71JFRO8MIlo_wo269k_o-f-rueObTQCCjtkdp6enXIU99EOUQd_4gfwtdOo7-gJwyJk-NQcCuRKB5bZdTLaq6Rx7v4R3hpG7nJNCuwJtnGjzYoJuXEsAsgvNTT9zy-jrdtGR2wiBPwoMTBvHVDp0k3TYP_q5xZJu2xq_jwLxvIvfrB9UVND8oguW6Ke7KVI-ASoK9HG0SfEyNWUJCQYBAxHpdhuQhIDjwpIID9Pamr3v0ZtLu3ti1478BP3zZVx4DW5Q9nzN_HWthcLTn3VuguoER1hA429LF7liCjm7BEl_EzCIj1su6rIFot5exOEgLQ%3D%3D) Dear Friend, Before you move on to your next email--I would appreciate it if you would take a few moments to participate in Hillsdale College's **National Survey on the Department of Justice.** The survey will only take a few moments of your time, and its subject affects your liberty and the very survival of the rule of law in America. **The current administration 's weaponization of the Department of Justice is unprecedented in American history.** Instead of protecting your God-given constitutional rights, the administration uses the Department of Justice to attack its political opponents... ...as well as Christians, parents, and anyone who dares to stand up for our constitutional liberties. At the same time, with the help of the media it... Covers up a two-tiered justice system that violates your constitutional rights
Hides the corruption of the ruling class
Attacks those with traditional viewpoints **That 's why I'm asking you to take the Hillsdale College National Survey on the Department of Justice.** By completing this survey, you will help us more clearly understand the views of mainstream Americans like you on this critical issue. Your responses will help Hillsdale strengthen its nationwide educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty--including the importance of the rule of law and checks and balances, which the American Founders saw as essential safeguards against corruption. Friend, you can complete the National Survey on the Department of Justice by using the link below: **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/department-of-justice-survey/](http://links.reclamingamericanfreedom.com/u/click?_t=5ec072595b1347f09b4bac0de82ea87d&_m=412bff79324d41c59b4bbf30ed5284a3&_e=QlRsipEQJpq6Qv7_WM5_hLTqWaF98KYNBsSccJQh97HQ5A53FsQ8kLEp7Kr47ABur6aY6fWskZyxNFVo3S4k71JFRO8MIlo_wo269k_o-f-rueObTQCCjtkdp6enXIU99EOUQd_4gfwtdOo7-gJwyJk-NQcCuRKB5bZdTLaq6Rx7v4R3hpG7nJNCuwJtnGjzYoJuXEsAsgvNTT9zy-jrdtGR2wiBPwoMTBvHVDp0k3RJdJp2cs_UCZjI4nWJMy_JEBYbxykcxyt-byijp_H7uskalvvOkjGLZzcEE5J1qqePX_DeK0pEnMtpx7k47IeI3eMs-tT5SNwe8-u3qsdNXJlxhnQpWgNpVr3eL0JwzGjwUtE7Vr8lBY2XFk6-XoJLs9xPy62StAgYbtAgWCsf9A%3D%3D)** The **Declaration of Independence** argues that **the purpose of just government is to secure our natural rights** and that **just government is founded on the consent of the governed.** Yet today's ruling class regularly disregards the will of the American people, and our rights--to the freedoms of speech, assembly, and religion, to due process, to gun ownership, and more--are under constant attack. **You and I know that liberty in America is under serious threat. But as I travel around the country, I tell the audiences I speak to how we are engaging in the fight against this threat.** A vital part of our efforts in this fight--in which Hillsdale College is a leader--is **reaching** and **teaching** millions of citizens, with the TRUTH about America's great heritage of liberty. We are heavily invested in our educational outreach efforts through our **Project to Defend Liberty Nationwide by Reaching and Teaching Millions.** These efforts include: **Teaching bright and principled students** --on our campuses in Hillsdale, Michigan, and Washington, D.C.--who receive a rigorous, **classical liberal arts education, including** a required course on the Constitution
**Distributing _Imprimis_** , America's leading digest of liberty, which is mailed to more than 6.4 million homes and businesses ten times per year; previous issues include "The Politicization of the Department of Justice" by Harmeet K. Dhillon
**Producing and promoting free online courses** for any citizen who wishes to learn, on topics such as the Constitution, American history, and free market economics
**Providing a classical K-12 curriculum** with a solid grounding in American history, constitutional government, and economics to schools that educate thousands of students nationwide After everything we've seen over the past few years, the need for Hillsdale's educational outreach efforts is undeniable. So please share your views by completing our **National Survey on the Department of Justice** and returning it to me as soon as possible. It will only take a few minutes of your time. Your completed survey will help us form the most effective strategy to **reach** and **teach** millions of Americans on behalf of liberty. As you might know, Hillsdale College is almost unique in American higher education in its refusal to accept EVEN ONE PENNY of government funding--not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants or loans. **This independence frees the College from burdensome and corrupting government regulations. But it also means that our work depends entirely on the generous support of private citizens, like you, who understand the importance of education to liberty.** If you agree that we are now seeing an unprecedented assault on the American way of life, I hope you will partner with Hillsdale College by making a generous tax-deductible gift today. You can easily do so after completing the attached **National Survey on the Department of Justice** , which you can access at this secure link: **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/department-of-justice-survey/](http://links.reclamingamericanfreedom.com/u/click?_t=5ec072595b1347f09b4bac0de82ea87d&_m=412bff79324d41c59b4bbf30ed5284a3&_e=QlRsipEQJpq6Qv7_WM5_hLTqWaF98KYNBsSccJQh97HQ5A53FsQ8kLEp7Kr47ABur6aY6fWskZyxNFVo3S4k71JFRO8MIlo_wo269k_o-f-rueObTQCCjtkdp6enXIU99EOUQd_4gfwtdOo7-gJwyJk-NQcCuRKB5bZdTLaq6Rx7v4R3hpG7nJNCuwJtnGjzYoJuXEsAsgvNTT9zy-jrdtGR2wiBPwoMTBvHVDp0k3RqBNIY3ljKzCUhuxycTOco0xXdHaLbQ4HbKL_dVJIT2dIukTSw1XzLOIcdMJjlzXgjjaMjSzrlDkRsUC0l3psRxZSST8YOMhPasjU3CqEtfYoiKTz16zEuTllN_7sTyZNy1zIIdtF0AI10O7d8XEmgbb-pVzxDXRctJrL8l8Z0cA%3D%3D)** Thank you for your time and attention. I look forward to receiving your completed survey, and I sincerely appreciate your support of Hillsdale's educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty. Warm regards, Larry P. Arnn President, Hillsdale College Pursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844 |

---

Dear Friend,

I hope you saw my announcement on Sean Hannity's show that I've partnered with the Leadership Institute to launch the Riley Gaines Center.

I'm the 12-time All-American swimmer who speaks out against transgender ideology and fights to defend basic truths - that men are men and women are women.

The Riley Gaines Center at the Leadership Institute is now the exclusive headquarters of my work to lead conservatives of all types - patriots who will not be silenced by the weight of the left's cultural pressure and who want to learn how to defend America's freedoms.

When the left tries to shout you down profanely, when they viciously attack you - that's when you know you're saying the right things.

For those who are attacked, vilified, and persecuted for their support of America's founding principles and traditional American values, the Riley Gaines Center sends a message that they are not alone - because I will stand bravely with them.

To train as many young people as I can to stand up for conservative principles, I must have the help of strong Leadership Institute supporters like you.

**[Will you help turn young men and women into Leaders for America?](https://links.fullmagnews.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=429b601b31ae493b9d1011de2719f080&_e=UmwA5qrb5slkf8P8RF9deylhdJiJODXpg6AbNDVvlwVxgLFMfZkKPhIFEJwsTR6lcwOvCQ3FH2tAoZSOCYWGDM8TTBUQxduOWOgKMT3UTLWJx9ngVW2kQoakGd7yhwVRXBfOlTX6gFZEF8yPwWpPUvgpSOWQowifSAVTruHWdEnEef4H-OesDtzTVjrcfX6ADQwZ6VfbBd9RTSAdflM30WLprGx54omkHE8bB740mWyDkuqc0B1NDhWldDZBvfxDLHS9mWhZMyXiM5sdjUT63KFQ2yFFHIWHqAlbBZW9MIZ5pc5MkZZ2SgYkVxmjOvO33xMdCO04nNbW16b-Xn25EeWULKighTo71OEJfV1z780%3D)**

The Riley Gaines Center is the exclusive home of my work to lead this crucial cause through:
* Speaking events and media appearances to rally everyday Americans to defend women's identity and uphold vital truths.

* A coalition of women, student athletes, parents, and those who have been harmed by radical transgender ideology, to join me in speaking out across the country.

* A fast-growing team of speakers and grassroots organizers, who will help turn those ready to defend freedom into champions who put their principles into action.

---
Through the Riley Gaines Center, my fellow Leadership Institute colleagues and I will identify, recruit, train, mentor, and empower students, athletes, and parents across the country to become campus, community, and national Leaders for America.

Not only will these young leaders help our country right now. They will stand up for our principles for decades to come.

**[By joining me and the Leadership Institute team with your contribution to this new effort, you make a powerful difference for conservatives across the country, from college campuses to the halls of power.](https://links.fullmagnews.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=429b601b31ae493b9d1011de2719f080&_e=UmwA5qrb5slkf8P8RF9deylhdJiJODXpg6AbNDVvlwVxgLFMfZkKPhIFEJwsTR6lcwOvCQ3FH2tAoZSOCYWGDM8TTBUQxduOWOgKMT3UTLWJx9ngVW2kQoakGd7yhwVRXBfOlTX6gFZEF8yPwWpPUvgpSOWQowifSAVTruHWdEnEef4H-OesDtzTVjrcfX6ADQwZ6VfbBd9RTSAdflM30SRs1AwLbwW1U2WmZUO-SXO8pbmptrJk9djGGoHc9xMPHKilmKNXPyglNoJUvcTXRLDrt0WhYwnnioczxlkOk48JWzepilQTbc8FiqOyet4Eq0H4rS82OOPdTwA3i40GkitARHj82UlzqW62Cm0LX1Q%3D)**

Their ingenuity, contrarian spirit, and unwavering courage breathed new life into seemingly lost causes. This is your opportunity to unravel the secrets of history's most influential leaders, unlocking invaluable lessons that resonate even in the present day.

Greg

name: ICYMI News
subject: Survey on the Department of Justice
body:
The survey will only take a few moments of your time

This sponsored message from ICYMI News is on behalf of Hillsdale College
[](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2zeiboqv2msg7jm6eco7oih88a964jf3no1k04kb8_rp22sh2s8i6eo36c9hm4or6cjh2bs) Dear Friend, Before you move on to your next email--I would appreciate it if you would take a few moments to participate in Hillsdale College's **National Survey on the Department of Justice.** The survey will only take a few moments of your time, and its subject affects your liberty and the very survival of the rule of law in America. **The current administration 's weaponization of the Department of Justice is unprecedented in American history.** Instead of protecting your God-given constitutional rights, the administration uses the Department of Justice to attack its political opponents... ...as well as Christians, parents, and anyone who dares to stand up for our constitutional liberties. At the same time, with the help of the media it...
* Covers up a two-tiered justice system that violates your constitutional rights

* Hides the corruption of the ruling class

* Attacks those with traditional viewpoints

**That 's why I'm asking you to take the Hillsdale College National Survey on the Department of Justice.** By completing this survey, you will help us more clearly understand the views of mainstream Americans like you on this critical issue. Your responses will help Hillsdale strengthen its nationwide educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty--including the importance of the rule of law and checks and balances, which the American Founders saw as essential safeguards against corruption. Friend, you can complete the National Survey on the Department of Justice by using the link below: **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/department-of-justice-survey/](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2z67blmekfkrh9l9hkel4b2s9g2vuqhtptg6ca8f8_rp22sh2s8i6eo36c9hm4or6cjh2bs)** The **Declaration of Independence** argues that **the purpose of just government is to secure our natural rights** and that **just government is founded on the consent of the governed.** Yet today's ruling class regularly disregards the will of the American people, and our rights--to the freedoms of speech, assembly, and religion, to due process, to gun ownership, and more--are under constant attack. **You and I know that liberty in America is under serious threat. But as I travel around the country, I tell the audiences I speak to how we are engaging in the fight against this threat.** A vital part of our efforts in this fight--in which Hillsdale College is a leader--is **reaching** and **teaching** millions of citizens, with the TRUTH about America's great heritage of liberty. We are heavily invested in our educational outreach efforts through our **Project to Defend Liberty Nationwide by Reaching and Teaching Millions.** These efforts include:
* **Teaching bright and principled students** --on our campuses in Hillsdale, Michigan, and Washington, D.C.--who receive a rigorous, **classical liberal arts education, including** a required course on the Constitution

* **Distributing _Imprimis_** , America's leading digest of liberty, which is mailed to more than 6.4 million homes and businesses ten times per year; previous issues include "The Politicization of the Department of Justice" by Harmeet K. Dhillon

* **Producing and promoting free online courses** for any citizen who wishes to learn, on topics such as the Constitution, American history, and free market economics

* **Providing a classical K-12 curriculum** with a solid grounding in American history, constitutional government, and economics to schools that educate thousands of students nationwide

After everything we've seen over the past few years, the need for Hillsdale's educational outreach efforts is undeniable. So please share your views by completing our **National Survey on the Department of Justice** and returning it to me as soon as possible. It will only take a few minutes of your time. Your completed survey will help us form the most effective strategy to **reach** and **teach** millions of Americans on behalf of liberty. As you might know, Hillsdale College is almost unique in American higher education in its refusal to accept EVEN ONE PENNY of government funding--not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants or loans. **This independence frees the College from burdensome and corrupting government regulations. But it also means that our work depends entirely on the generous support of private citizens, like you, who understand the importance of education to liberty.** If you agree that we are now seeing an unprecedented assault on the American way of life, I hope you will partner with Hillsdale College by making a generous tax-deductible gift today. You can easily do so after completing the attached **National Survey on the Department of Justice** , which you can access at this secure link: **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/department-of-justice-survey/](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2zgmq38h4vq4q1lapnlj6kdi88v2qfh9oemua063o_rp22sh2s8i6eo36c9hm4or6cjh2bs)** Thank you for your time and attention. I look forward to receiving your completed survey, and I sincerely appreciate your support of Hillsdale's educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty. Warm regards, Larry P. Arnn President, Hillsdale College Pursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844 |

# **FOX & Friends Features Breakthrough Solar Generator**
_**Demand Is Surging - 107,000 Americans Have Already Claimed Theirs...**_ [](http://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/2q2v89smzswp5GvrVjWfgA~~/AARclAA~/RgRnaCSiP0RmaHR0cHM6Ly90cmsucmVib290bWFya2V0aW5nLmNvbS9hZmZfYz9vZmZlcl9pZD0xMTImYWZmX2lkPTE1MjAmYWZmX3N1YjI9UE9QUFBHODUxMjAxMjNfUk1fUk9OXzIwMjMxMjIyVwNzcGNCCmWDaXeFZaVsoi5SFGRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tWAQAAAAA) FOX & Friends featured a breakthrough solar generator right before a "polar vortex" sent thousands of Americans into total darkness. Skip Bedell recommended it as the perfect gift to prepare for winter storms. **_And then BOOM!_** _**Demand surged and 4Patriots sold out.**_ Days later, a massive ice storm hit the nation. The folks who were fortunate enough to claim their silent, fume-free solar generator were thanking their lucky stars. Because despite power outages, rolling blackouts and bone-chilling temperatures... Those who acted fast and got their [**4Patriots solar generator**](http://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/2q2v89smzswp5GvrVjWfgA~~/AARclAA~/RgRnaCSiP0RmaHR0cHM6Ly90cmsucmVib290bWFya2V0aW5nLmNvbS9hZmZfYz9vZmZlcl9pZD0xMTImYWZmX2lkPTE1MjAmYWZmX3N1YjI9UE9QUFBHODUxMjAxMjNfUk1fUk9OXzIwMjMxMjIyVwNzcGNCCmWDaXeFZaVsoi5SFGRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tWAQAAAAA) had peace of mind and could power critical devices like lights, space heaters, communications, critical medical devices and even fridges and freezers. Sadly, those who didn't prepare were left to hope and pray the lights came back on soon. **But that's not why this generator is going viral...** **National Security Experts Fear Imminent Threat to Our Power Grid** Freak ice storms, hurricanes and raging wildfires aren't the only threat to our nation's crumbling power grid... Shockingly, in 2022 alone there were over 70 physical attacks on our nation's power grid! And even worse, attacks on just 9 of the nation's 55,000 electrical substations could trigger... **A nationwide blackout that could last up to 18 months!** Former CIA Director, James Woolsey, warned that an attack on America's infrastructure would, _"Blackout the national electric grid and other life-sustaining critical infrastructures for over a year. Killing 9 out of 10 Americans by starvation and societal collapse."_ Despite this clear and present danger... **Our Government is Woefully Unprepared** They ignore dire warnings from national security experts about our vulnerable power grid. Warnings of physical, electro-magnetic pulse (EMP) and cyberattacks... And who suffers because of their neglect? YOU and your family. **Imagine a blackout lasting not days, but weeks or months.** Your life would be frozen in time right at the moment your power fails. An entire country plunged into darkness. Without a generator, your fridge, electric range and microwave would be dead. All the food in your fridge and freezer - spoiled. Your well couldn't pump fresh water into your house. And even if you don't have a well, a total grid failure means no fresh water to drink, cook or clean with. This is not some crazy doomsday theory. It's a real threat. **That's why many Americans are taking matters into their own hands and are securing their own solar powered generator.** Solar generators are a smart choice because they produce an endless supply of life-saving electricity when you need it most - and **without gas, fumes or noise**. Our top recommendation in portable solar generators is the [**Patriot Power Generator**](http://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/2q2v89smzswp5GvrVjWfgA~~/AARclAA~/RgRnaCSiP0RmaHR0cHM6Ly90cmsucmVib290bWFya2V0aW5nLmNvbS9hZmZfYz9vZmZlcl9pZD0xMTImYWZmX2lkPTE1MjAmYWZmX3N1YjI9UE9QUFBHODUxMjAxMjNfUk1fUk9OXzIwMjMxMjIyVwNzcGNCCmWDaXeFZaVsoi5SFGRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tWAQAAAAA). **THIS breakthrough solar generator is safe enough to use inside. And never needs gas, ever.** And you'll have peace of mind knowing that you and your family have a safe, reliable and easy-to-use source of backup power. # Outrageous: Removal of President Trump from the CO Ballot and Potential Removal from the MD Ballot
---
|

|
---
| [Contribute to Dan Cox for Congress](https://coxforcongress.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=866897dcd900340c866a1068a&id=b3d3f14cd5&e=5bb5efcda7 "Contribute to Dan Cox for Congress")
---
| URGENT: STATEMENT DEMANDING NO ELECTION INTERFERENCE

Friends, Just this week's shocking news impacting our Republic includes:
* Colorado [has removed President Trump](https://coxforcongress.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=866897dcd900340c866a1068a&id=ebba796884&e=5bb5efcda7) from its ballot and now California [and Maryland are said to be considering the same](https://coxforcongress.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=866897dcd900340c866a1068a&id=e3f766f06a&e=5bb5efcda7);
* Jack Smith is [an illegitimate prosecutor](https://coxforcongress.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=866897dcd900340c866a1068a&id=31ffba93fc&e=5bb5efcda7) illegally operating out from under the Constitution, says President Reagan's Attorney General Ed Meese;
* Our Southern Border is being invaded like no other time in US History i[ncluding 10 IEDs (explosive devices) being found](https://coxforcongress.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=866897dcd900340c866a1068a&id=2fe28edd52&e=5bb5efcda7) on vehicles, and the Biden Admin is actively allowing this invasion of our states and cities.

What can we do about it? You can [join and help me today](https://coxforcongress.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=866897dcd900340c866a1068a&id=bee67519d0&e=5bb5efcda7).
I am demanding that our Secretary of State not remove President Trump from the Maryland ballot. More than half of the voters in America (62% of Independents!) now say they are worse off under Biden and 61% of all Americans say they were better off under President Trump [in this week's recent Harvard poll.](https://coxforcongress.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=866897dcd900340c866a1068a&id=644fedd0f0&e=5bb5efcda7) Now, Democrats nationally are attempting to prevent these voters from voting for President Trump. They are freaking out and acting dictatorially; this attempt to keep Trump off our ballot is nothing short of extremist election interference.

"Silence in the face of evil, is evil." Those are the words of Rev. Dietrich Bonhoeffer.

Yet, sadly, too many are silent in the face of this outrageous attack on our Republic. Not me.

I will not be silent. I will speak for us. Colorado must reinstate President Trump on the ballot and I demand that our Secretary of State not remove Trump from Maryland's ballot. Congress should cause the immediate firing of Jack Smith by entirely defunding him and the Supreme Court should release from prison all those whom he illegally prosecuted. And Congress and the President must close the Border and save our country before it falls to high crime and lawlessness.

These issues and more I will fight for in Congress. But I need your immediate contribution to reach our end of the year goal. There are only 9 days left to raise our funds for our first FEC report. Thank you for helping today by [donating here](https://coxforcongress.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=866897dcd900340c866a1068a&id=ce991baffc&e=5bb5efcda7).

Freedom and victory,

Dan Cox
P.S. Our Border is wide-open, pouring in international terrorists and foreign nationals from all over the world including our enemies. If we don't act now in this election, we can kiss American freedom goodbye and I pray we don't lose loved ones to violence from incoming terrorist cells. Please chip in the best you can to help me win this race.

| "DEI must DIE. The point was to end discrimination, not replace it with different discrimination."
That is what Elon Musk [said recently](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=0018kVDL46h1uXR7myRi4n3VkAX4K57Pb8XM-9mxk3KaUW8HzVhtz8sxzV2tKo-QZHxmco2ueHqv-KcN3Gs86Zni8iGz1W2briZS52G00h9rryvgyPh8cgGrDzdsvHEDF0CKdBkQyeBiRSvRw1t11hpuej5geotR1HHDWXzoiNyMHAvdCZJE5ZyRW9GagDp-SBb&c=sIF58CJQeNa0qk84_H94Zlcp4m4nFFEIe1CVClOMGmc7RuhQN0tBKA==&ch=VquejjMOXZak_pFl1hOllWe1a7iWkqLjRIIJGVQ378t7PEtEFKabWw==) about the so-called "diversity, equity, and inclusion" movement that has swept across America in recent years and corrupted core institutions in our country.
Perhaps no institution has been harmed more by DEI initiatives than America's college campuses.
We see the utter moral bankruptcy in higher education with the spread of antisemitism on college campuses.
The presidents of some of America's Ivy League universities cannot even say that calls for genocide against Jews amounts to a violation of their codes of conduct.
Make no mistake - this is a direct byproduct of the DEI initiatives that have infected America's universities.
That's why I'm fighting back.
I just announced new legislation to halt federal funding to colleges and universities that force students to sign or make DEI statements.
My bill will ban places of higher education from compelling students, staff, or applicants to endorse an ideology that promotes the differential treatment of an individual or group of individuals based on race, color, or ethnicity.
This is what is needed in order to change the culture on college campuses from incubators of woke, progressive, and often antisemetic nonsense to their original purposes of advancing educational excellence.
The rot that we've seen spread across America's universities is a direct result of the heightened focus on DEI in recent years, and it needs to stop.

| The decision by the Colorado Supreme Court to remove Donald Trump from their presidential ballot is un-American and unconstitutional. Moreover, it reflects a profound misunderstanding and disrespect for American democracy.
To unilaterally remove the right of Colorado's voters to cast a ballot for their preferred choice for president, without any due process whatsoever, is an obvious overreach that must be corrected. For all the talk from the left about Republicans "destroying democracy," this decision from Democrat judges in Colorado represents a subversion of democracy on a level we have not witnessed before.
The United States Supreme Court must immediately reverse this decision and it should be a 9-0 ruling in favor of keeping Donald Trump on the ballot. There are several other states considering similar efforts to remove Donald Trump from their respective ballots, which is why it is critical that the Supreme Court step in now to right this obvious wrong.

| MULTIPLE CRISES PILING UP ON OUR SOUTHERN BORDER
---

| [CLICK HERE TO WATCH](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=0018kVDL46h1uXR7myRi4n3VkAX4K57Pb8XM-9mxk3KaUW8HzVhtz8sxzV2tKo-QZHx1Pvq5-T55l3ZPpLhTLckx49F0M0KKqYprETGqP12Op0pXFGh3tv4D-id-jHvWbyHM36yp76kDzKWB8GiCLCt5suqE8r2lPCGKqw20-Hj11uXMQwiCzXN_g==&c=sIF58CJQeNa0qk84_H94Zlcp4m4nFFEIe1CVClOMGmc7RuhQN0tBKA==&ch=VquejjMOXZak_pFl1hOllWe1a7iWkqLjRIIJGVQ378t7PEtEFKabWw==)
---
| The surge in illegal immigration at our southern border - caused and allowed to continue by Joe Biden - have caused a multitude of crises to pile up.
We have a crisis of sovereignty, with virtually no ability to control who is coming into our country. We have a crisis of security, with militant cartels flooding fentanyl into America and killing tens of thousands of our citizens every year. And we have an economic crisis brewing, with the chaos at our border disrupting critical rail operations that facilitate trade between the United States and Mexico.
Joe Biden and Democrats are finally understanding the need to address this problem, mostly because they understand it represents a serious political vulnerability for them. But don't be fooled by the solutions they're proposing to address it.
Joe Biden likes to brag that he has requested money from Congress to address the border crisis. But the money Biden is requesting won't do anything to fix the actual problem - all it will do is make the problem look prettier. Biden wants resources to ensure we're not seeing massive lines at our border, to make the illegal immigrants more comfortable as they wait to enter our country, and to gloss over the images we see every single day with thousands of illegal immigrants flowing into our country.
This problem doesn't need money thrown at it. We need serious policy changes, including reforms to our asylum laws to prevent bogus asylum claims and reforms to parole laws to prevent illegal immigrants from being released into our country with no plan to deport them. We also need to reinstate the Remain in Mexico policy that deterred illegal immigration during the Trump Administration.
All of this could be achieved right now if the Biden White House engaged in serious negotiations with the Republican-controlled House instead of the Democrat-controlled Senate. The Republican House majority needs to demand that any further aid to Ukraine is tied to serious policy changes at our southern border so we can finally get this crisis under control.
I will continue to push for this when Congress returns in the New Year.

clean_body: | | | | | | | | == | Peter – This week, I introduced legislation to stop the DEI initiatives that have corrupted the culture on college campuses across the country. I also spoke out against the Colorado Supreme Court's decision to remove President Trump from the ballot and the continued illegal immigration crisis at our southern border. As I gear up for my re-election campaign, I need the support of committed patriots like you from across the country. With a small contribution, you can help ensure I have the resources I need to win my race and continue fighting for you on the issues that matter most in Congress. == | | | == | As always, thank you for your continued support. Now, here's your brief. | | | | | | | | ELON MUSK IS RIGHT: DEI NEEDS TO DIE | | | | == | | | "DEI must DIE. The point was to end discrimination, not replace it with different discrimination." That is what Elon Musk == about the so-called "diversity, equity, and inclusion" movement that has swept across America in recent years and corrupted core institutions in our country. Perhaps no institution has been harmed more by DEI initiatives than America's college campuses. We see the utter moral bankruptcy in higher education with the spread of antisemitism on college campuses. The presidents of some of America's Ivy League universities cannot even say that calls for genocide against Jews amounts to a violation of their codes of conduct. Make no mistake - this is a direct byproduct of the DEI initiatives that have infected America's universities. That's why I'm fighting back. I just announced new legislation to halt federal funding to colleges and universities that force students to sign or make DEI statements. My bill will ban places of higher education from compelling students, staff, or applicants to endorse an ideology that promotes the differential treatment of an individual or group of individuals based on race, color, or ethnicity. This is what is needed in order to change the culture on college campuses from incubators of woke, progressive, and often antisemetic nonsense to their original purposes of advancing educational excellence. The rot that we've seen spread across America's universities is a direct result of the heightened focus on DEI in recent years, and it needs to stop. | | | | | | | | THE COLORADO SUPREME COURT DOESN'T UNDERSTAND DEMOCRACY | | The decision by the Colorado Supreme Court to remove Donald Trump from their presidential ballot is un-American and unconstitutional. Moreover, it reflects a profound misunderstanding and disrespect for American democracy. To unilaterally remove the right of Colorado's voters to cast a ballot for their preferred choice for president, without any due process whatsoever, is an obvious overreach that must be corrected. For all the talk from the left about Republicans "destroying democracy," this decision from Democrat judges in Colorado represents a subversion of democracy on a level we have not witnessed before. The United States Supreme Court must immediately reverse this decision and it should be a 9-0 ruling in favor of keeping Donald Trump on the ballot. There are several other states considering similar efforts to remove Donald Trump from their respective ballots, which is why it is critical that the Supreme Court step in now to right this obvious wrong. | | | | | | MULTIPLE CRISES PILING UP ON OUR SOUTHERN BORDER | | == | The surge in illegal immigration at our southern border - caused and allowed to continue by Joe Biden - have caused a multitude of crises to pile up. We have a crisis of sovereignty, with virtually no ability to control who is coming into our country. We have a crisis of security, with militant cartels flooding fentanyl into America and killing tens of thousands of our citizens every year. And we have an economic crisis brewing, with the chaos at our border disrupting critical rail operations that facilitate trade between the United States and Mexico. Joe Biden and Democrats are finally understanding the need to address this problem, mostly because they understand it represents a serious political vulnerability for them. But don't be fooled by the solutions they're proposing to address it. Joe Biden likes to brag that he has requested money from Congress to address the border crisis. But the money Biden is requesting won't do anything to fix the actual problem - all it will do is make the problem look prettier. Biden wants resources to ensure we're not seeing massive lines at our border, to make the illegal immigrants more comfortable as they wait to enter our country, and to gloss over the images we see every single day with thousands of illegal immigrants flowing into our country. This problem doesn't need money thrown at it. We need serious policy changes, including reforms to our asylum laws to prevent bogus asylum claims and reforms to parole laws to prevent illegal immigrants from being released into our country with no plan to deport them. We also need to reinstate the Remain in Mexico policy that deterred illegal immigration during the Trump Administration. All of this could be achieved right now if the Biden White House engaged in serious negotiations with the Republican-controlled House instead of the Democrat-controlled Senate. The Republican House majority needs to demand that any further aid to Ukraine is tied to serious policy changes at our southern border so we can finally get this crisis under control. subject: Caucus Room Member Communication
body:
No images? [Click here](https://caucusroom.cmail19.com/t/i-e-aidityk-trhiujldw-j/) [](https://caucusroom.cmail19.com/t/i-l-aidityk-trhiujldw-r/) **Caucus Room Members** **What is Happening Next?****Caucus Room will be implementing a "Factory Reset" January 1, 2024**** _What does not change_** Members join for free.Members are placed in a neighborhood (their county) based on where they vote.Existing Members are verified conservatives and new Members will be added only after the same screening.Communication is secure. Caucus Room uses dedicated servers.Member data is not sold.**_What changes_** All news feeds will be eliminated.All advertising will be eliminated.All communication between Members will be take place solely in their neighborhood.All current groups will cease to exist December 31.Beginning January 1, new Groups will be created by hosts at the county level. Hosts will recruit Members to join their Group from their neighborhood.All Groups will be hosted on Caucus Room Live for $24/$50 per month paid by the Group Host.**_What do you need to do _**Nothing to remain a Member.Between now and January 1, check out Caucus Room Live.Beginning January 1, form a group. It is simple to do. Just login, click on the "Create a Group" Icon and follow the instructions. Action and change require organization. Identifying problems is easy. Crafting solutions and implementing change is difficult. Caucus Room Live virtual meetings are the easiest and safest place to make that happen. Why not Zoom, Microsoft Teams, Google Meets, etc.? Read the Privacy Statement and Terms of Service sections for these entities. Is your personal and group data secure? Can your information be shared? Can you be cancelled for your views/beliefs?Ask your county Republican Party Chair to form a group on Caucus Room. This is a concrete step you can take to encourage the Republican Party to represent your values and help elect those you support.Consider hosting a county level group for your favorite state-wide or national group. The state-wide and national groups need people in each county to implement their ideas and plans. Great ideas are only great if they have a way to become reality. You are the key.Form a group to support a candidate or cause. Candidates are desperate for engaged conservatives supporters. Caucus Room is a ready-made support infrastructure. There are nearly 100,000 Caucus Room Members located in over 3,000 counties. Caucus Room looks forward with excitement to see Members form groups in January so we know that our Members value the Caucus Room Live platform and services Caucus Room provides. Our target is 1,000 groups to form, representing 1% of our Members in a third of our counties. When that happens Caucus Room will know you value what we offer. There are improvements we want to make, and will begin, as soon as we know that Members want to use the Caucus Room platform to meet and bring positive change to their communities.Merry Christmas,John CoorsManager, Caucus Room LLCjohnc@caucusroom.com

subject: How you can defeat radical leftism
body:
Unfortunately, a conservative victory in the next election is not enough to save our country.

| | | [](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c688603%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=OTtgJKMxLJqzyqiDKx6m0g&sysid=1)

Dear Fellow Patriot,

The next presidential administration could be a turning point for our country.

After years of inflation, open borders, reckless spending, and rampant crime, America desperately needs effective governance grounded in our founding principles.

Unfortunately, a conservative victory in the next election is not enough to save our country.

That’s because today, the deep state controls D.C.

**Regardless of who is in office, career bureaucrats in our federal agencies like the Justice Department, Environmental Protection Agency, and the State Department independently push their own leftist agendas.

**In order to implement common-sense, conservative policies, we must have a plan to rein in these agencies and replace these leftist bureaucrats with principled conservatives.

The Heritage Foundation has that plan--called Project 2025.

**Through Project 2025, The Heritage Foundation has united 80 conservative organizations and is leading the charge for the next presidential transition plan.**

Heritage’s policy scholars created a comprehensive policy book and a plan to implement it starting day one of the next administration.

These policies include securing our borders, ensuring election integrity, and reversing the growth of regulations, spending, and inflation.

Additionally, we’re identifying and training qualified patriots to staff the next administration and replace the leftist bureaucrats - ending their control of the deep state.

**The radical leftist mainstream media has published several panicked articles attacking Heritage and Project 2025.**

But as we like to say, if the leftist media is angry at you, you’re over the target.

As 2024 rapidly approaches, we’re kicking Project 2025 into high gear.

Will you help us make this much needed program a massive success? Will you support Project 2025 with a special gift today?

Sincerely,

Kevin D. Roberts, Ph.D.

name: Gov. Chris Sununu
subject: Why I’m proud to endorse Nikki Haley
body:
I am asking you to join me in supporting her today.

| |
---
| | |
Friend,

It's Governor Chris Sununu.

**[I am proud to endorse Nikki Haley for President, and I am asking you to join me in supporting her today.](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zdh4jm505aj831tn9l2lsijqctejr26patp5vv1o_rp22sh2s8i6eo36c9jm8or2cjh2bs "I am proud to endorse Nikki Haley for President, and I am asking you to join me in supporting her today.")**

---
| [](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zt7mu42kmblfum8pskulheju8dqgtvjhoq7s10do_rp22sh2s8i6eo36c9jm8or2cjh2bs)
---
| | [SUPPORT NIKKI HALEY](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2z7lj74sdb6ddjdhd4khf25hgftt7iakdscnna97g_rp22sh2s8i6eo36c9jm8or2cjh2bs)
---

When Nikki was first elected to statewide office as part of the 2010 Tea Party wave, she energized South Carolinians in her race for governor and never looked back.

As governor, she balanced budgets and prioritized limited government and local control.

As the U.S. ambassador to the United Nations, she took on China and Russia, and understands that world peace comes from American strength. She stands with our allies in Israel and Ukraine.

She will crack down on illegal immigration and stop the flow of deadly fentanyl pouring over our southern border. In these uncertain times, she offers a steady hand to right the ship here at home and abroad.

Nikki Haley is surging in New Hampshire because she's running a true "Live Free or Die" campaign. She's pounding the pavement, meeting voters in their living rooms, holding town halls, and going diner-to-diner. She's not just talking wherever she goes, she's listening -- and that's what it takes to be a great leader. She's looked us in the eye, answered our questions, and taken the time to build trust.

We must consolidate behind one candidate -- the candidate who has the best chance of victory.

That candidate is Nikki Haley.

I hope you will join me in supporting Nikki Haley for president. **[Please consider making a contribution to her campaign today.](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zgbnfq3k7focsanlsq9dga1ln927nluaf1mqm61g_rp22sh2s8i6eo36c9jm8or2cjh2bs "Please consider making a contribution to her campaign today.")**

Thank you,
Gov. Chris Sununu

---
My name is Nikki Haley. I want to tell you a bit about myself and why I'm running for President of the United States.

I'm running for President because my parents came to America more than 50 years ago - an America that was strong and proud, and full of opportunities. I want them to know that America again.

I'm running for President as a military spouse. My husband is deployed and I want him and his military brothers and sisters to know their sacrifice means something - that we do love this country.

I'm running for President for the future of our kids. I have a daughter who just got married and I saw how hard it was for her and her husband to buy a home. I'm doing this for my son who's a senior in college and shouldn't have to worry about saying things on a paper that he doesn't believe in just to get an A.

I'm running for my daughter, my son, and our future generations. I want them to experience the freedom and opportunity that the American Dream has to offer.

_**I 'm running for President because we have a country to save! **_

I've seen that even on our worst days, we are blessed to live in America. But I also know that under Biden's leadership, times are tough, our future is slipping, and America can be doing so much better.

**As governor, I was dubbed a "jobs governor"** because I slashed our unemployment rate, brought jobs back to our state, and shepherded in a successful economic recovery.

**At the UN I fought for America,** made sure our allies knew we had their backs and stood up to murderers and dictators to let them know that America was taking names.

I know how to make America strong and proud because I've done it before. **And I 'll do it as your next President. **

As President, I'll revitalize our economy, support small businesses, stop Washington's spending sprees, protect our border, champion school choice, and save America's future.

**[Will you join me today and help me save our country?](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zjprfemqnmmfv2oprkn0ma0tq4muhe036crlmb6g_rp22sh2s8i6eo36c9jm8or2cjh2bs "Will you join me today and help me save our country?")**

| | From our family to yours, Merry Christmas! There’s nothing quite like being home for the holidays, especially when home is the great state of Tennessee. I’ll be enjoying a long-held tradition with Kelly and Isabel, watching _It’s a Wonderful Life_. I find that the message in this movie is relevant and important every year. In addition to being a simple story about one man’s ability to touch so many people and make a difference, it’s also a reminder to count our blessings and hold our loved ones close. The movie is a testament to friendship, family, and sacrifice—and I'm so grateful to live in a community that values all those things. As you gather with family and friends in the coming days, I pray you’ll feel an overwhelming sense of joy and gratitude. May your Christmas be filled with love, warmth, and the company of those who matter most to you! Here’s to a beautiful end to 2023 and a promising start to the new year! I know 2024 will be bright.

| | I had the privilege of speaking last weekend at Knoxville National Cemetery, the place where my father, a brave World War II veteran, was laid to rest. Wreaths Across America is an incredible organization that coordinates wreath-laying ceremonies at more than 4,225 veterans cemeteries. When a volunteer places a wreath on a veteran's grave, they’re asked to speak that veteran's name out loud and thank them for their service and sacrifice. This is one of my favorite events each year, and I am thankful for any opportunity I get to honor my father and the countless other heroes who courageously fought for our country. On that note, I also want to extend my heartfelt gratitude to those currently serving who miss holidays with their families to keep us safe and free. We live in the greatest country in the world, thanks to you!

clean_body: TIMtalk will keep you updated on the important issues and goings-on in our campaign, in Tennessee, and in our country.| | | | | | | | Merry Christmas 🎄 | | From our family to yours, Merry Christmas! There’s nothing quite like being home for the holidays, especially when home is the great state of Tennessee. I’ll be enjoying a long-held tradition with Kelly and Isabel, watching It’s a Wonderful Life. I find that the message in this movie is relevant and important every year. In addition to being a simple story about one man’s ability to touch so many people and make a difference, it’s also a reminder to count our blessings and hold our loved ones close. The movie is a testament to friendship, family, and sacrifice—and I'm so grateful to live in a community that values all those things. As you gather with family and friends in the coming days, I pray you’ll feel an overwhelming sense of joy and gratitude. May your Christmas be filled with love, warmth, and the company of those who matter most to you! Here’s to a beautiful end to 2023 and a promising start to the new year! I know 2024 will be bright. | | | | | Never Forgotten 🪖 | | I had the privilege of speaking last weekend at Knoxville National Cemetery, the place where my father, a brave World War II veteran, was laid to rest. Wreaths Across America is an incredible organization that coordinates wreath-laying ceremonies at more than 4,225 veterans cemeteries. When a volunteer places a wreath on a veteran's grave, they’re asked to speak that veteran's name out loud and thank them for their service and sacrifice. This is one of my favorite events each year, and I am thankful for any opportunity I get to honor my father and the countless other heroes who courageously fought for our country. On that note, I also want to extend my heartfelt gratitude to those currently serving who miss holidays with their families to keep us safe and free. subject: I want to talk about the challenges facing our democracy.
